stories.title: Tool Schema and Validation Contract
stories.description: Define Pydantic schemas for all allowlisted tools including strict input models, optional/required fields, defaulting rules, and standardized validation error responses (422 contract). Schemas must align exactly with Anthropic tool_use JSON structure (name, input payload) and existing tool_models modules.

stories.title: Allowlist-Based Tool Routing Logic
stories.description: Implement core routing logic that dispatches tool calls using an explicit allowlist. Reject unknown tools, bind each tool to its Pydantic schema, validate inputs, and normalize invocation payloads prior to execution.

stories.title: Chat History Injection into Tool Context
stories.description: Implement controlled chat history injection into tool execution context, including truncation/token limits, role filtering, and de-identification aligned with consent_service and safety_service patterns. Ensure compatibility with downstream domain services.

stories.title: Tool Router API Integration with Main Loop
stories.description: Integrate tool routing and validation into the FastAPI main loop: parse Anthropic tool_use blocks, invoke router dispatch, handle validation errors with structured responses, and normalize tool outputs back into Anthropic-compatible response blocks for the agent loop.

stories.title: Tool Routing and Validation Test Suite
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering allowlist enforcement, schema validation (success and failure), tool dispatch correctness, chat history injection behavior, and Anthropic tool_use loop edge cases.
